messages:
Maya Patel: Quick scheduling thread — we need coordinated X + LinkedIn posts + webinar follow-up for the Benchmark v2 launch. Webinar is Wed May 5 10:00am PT. Assets needed: hero image (1200x675 & 1200x627), 30s promo clip, 4 mini X threads, LinkedIn copy. Marketing ops: can you confirm scheduling windows and UTMs? Also need lead routing tags for Growth (benchmark_launch, webinar_reg).

Sam O'Neill: Got it. I can draft the X threads and short LinkedIn variant. Can we avoid posting the day-of between 11am-1pm PT? Lots of internal meetings.

Devon Li: I'll export the hero from Figma today. Do we want both sizes exported or do we crop for each platform?

Maya Patel: Both sizes pls — LinkedIn 1200x627, X preview 1200x675. Export as PNG + high-quality JPG for ads. Tag uploads in #marketing-assets when ready. :thumbsup:

Anya Rodriguez: Scheduling plan suggestion: teaser 3 days before, reminder 1 hour before, live reminder 10m before, follow-up with recording 24h after. I can queue in Sprout — need final copy + UTMs + landing page.

Sam O'Neill: Use these UTMs: `?utm_source=x_social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bench_v2_launch` Landing page: `/benchmark?ref=social`. I'll pin a canonical X thread after the webinar with the recording.

Devon Li: Uploaded initial exports: `/assets/bench_v2_hero_1200x627.png` and `/assets/bench_v2_hero_1200x675.png`. Working on 30s mp4 now, will add to the same folder.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Growth tagging please — @Ezra (marketing-bot) can you confirm creation of webhook + tags so webinar signups are flagged `benchmark_launch` and `webinar_reg` in staging and prod?

Ezra (marketing-bot): webhooks and tags created. Created tags: `benchmark_launch`, `webinar_reg`, `social_engaged`. Test payload posted to staging CRM webhook — response 200. :white_check_mark:

Anya Rodriguez: Engagement plan: we need 2 responders per channel for the first 2 hours after each post. Sam + I can cover X; Maya can monitor LinkedIn. Suggested reply templates: 1) "Thanks! Here's the recording/CTA" 2) "Short stat from the benchmark" 3) "Want a demo? Link to schedule" — I'll write these out.

Sam O'Neill: Drafting 4 X mini-threads: teaser (stat + CTA), deep-dive stat thread (4 tweets), customer highlight, and post-webinar CTAs. Proposed posting times: teaser Tue 9:00am PT, thread Wed 8:00am PT, reminder Wed 9:00am PT (1h before), recording Thu 10:00am PT.

Maya Patel: Looks good. Small schedule snippet for ops: 
```
Teaser: Tue 09:00 PT
Thread: Wed 08:00 PT
Reminder: Wed 09:00 PT
Recording follow-up: Thu 10:00 PT
```
Please use the UTMs Sam supplied.

Devon Li: Added `bench_v2_prompts.pdf` and `bench_v2_clip_30s.mp4` to `/assets/bench_v2/`. Also exported a short GIF for X preview.

Anya Rodriguez: I'll queue everything in Sprout and assign owner tags. Will set responder rotations and add the reply templates to the scheduler notes. Will ping when live. :rocket:

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Quick follow-up: collect 3 prompt examples and a one-pager highlight for the thread narrative so replies can reference content quickly. Devon — can you add those to the assets zip?

Devon Li: Done — `bench_v2_prompt_examples.pdf` and `bench_v2_onepager.pdf` uploaded.

Sam O'Neill: I'll prepare messaging variants: short, medium, and long for each platform and drop in this thread by EOD.

Maya Patel: Amazing. Follow-up check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT. If anything blocks scheduling or Growth integration, drop it here and @me. :pray:
